name: Joku Ani no Tsuma ~Isourou no Gitei~
original_name: 辱・兄の妻～居候の義弟～
source:
Sachiyo was a droolingly hot but happily married wife, and her husband's little brother was no longer welcome. He'd spent 7 months mooching around their house and she was fed up. Then some pair of her panties went missing, so she went to the wash machine ... and discovered his semen in her shorts.
